aa.label: dog
aa.definition: An individual domestic dog or an explicitly counted group of dogs.

ab.label: cat
ab.definition: An individual domestic cat or an explicitly counted group of cats.

ac.label: child
ac.definition: A child; age and identity otherwise unspecified.

ad.label: teacher
ad.definition: A person described in the role of teacher.

af.label: book
af.definition: A book as a physical object.

ag.label: named_person
ag.definition: A person designated by a literal name; no cross-language name equivalence is asserted.

ah.label: park
ah.definition: A park used as the location of an event or state.

ai.label: home
ai.definition: A home used as a location; ownership is unspecified.

bb.label: see
bb.definition: An agent visually perceives a patient.

bd.label: give
bd.definition: An agent transfers a patient to a recipient.
